title: Kestrel Logistics Rate Card: Delivery & Pickup Appointments Delivery Fees
content:
Rate card for the delivery fee on Delivery & Pickup Appointments. One delivery fee applies to each appointment. The figures for each fulfillment method are set out below.

| Fulfillment method | Base delivery fee | Distance covered by the base fee (included radius) | Per-mile fee beyond the included radius | Delivery fee cap per appointment | Delivery fee waived on an exchange replacement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | $0.00 | 0 miles | $0.00 per mile | $0.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | $0.00 | 0 miles | $0.00 per mile | $0.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | $0.00 | 0 miles | $0.00 per mile | $0.00 | No |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | $0.00 | 100 miles | $0.00 per mile | $0.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | $199.00 | 100 miles | $1.25 per mile | $399.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | $499.00 | 100 miles | $1.95 per mile | $1299.00 | Yes |

### Notes to the rate card

1. **Base delivery fee**: the flat fee for the appointment, before any per-mile charge.
2. **Included radius**: the distance from the hub that the base fee covers, in whole miles.
3. **Per-mile fee**: the charge for each mile of distance from the hub beyond the included radius, in dollars per mile.
4. **Delivery fee cap**: the most the delivery fee on one appointment can be.
5. **Exchange replacement**: the replacement vehicle supplied under a 7-day exchange. "Yes" means the method waives the delivery fee for that replacement vehicle. "No" means it does not.

### Rate card questions

**Which methods have a per-mile charge?** Only Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery ($1.25 per mile) and Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery ($1.95 per mile). Every other method shows $0.00 per mile.

**What is the highest delivery fee a single appointment can carry under Extended-Zone and White-Glove?** The caps: $399.00 for Extended-Zone and $1299.00 for White-Glove.

**Which method does not waive the delivery fee for an exchange replacement?** Kestrel Fly & Drive. All five other methods waive it.
